reviewDescription: I could tell right away when I opened the package that these earbuds were a step up in quality from others I’ve owned. They both look and feel well made, not cheap or flimsy. I’m not an audio expert, but the sound quality genuinely impressed me. Clear, balanced, and strong right out of the box. That said, I specifically chose these because I was hoping they would be smaller than other earbuds I’ve tried. They aren’t. Even with the smallest ear tips, they don’t fit securely in my ears. They sort of rest in place rather than locking in. The weight helps keep them from falling out easily, but the fit isn’t ideal for smaller ear canals. Overall, I think these are excellent quality for the price and would likely work great for someone with average or larger ears. If you have smaller ear canals like I do, the fit may be a challenge.
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on March 5, 2026
